annotations.title: Find the best x402 API for a task

description: Say what you need in plain words ('verify an email', 'read a web page', 'company record for a domain') and get the x402 endpoints that do it, best first, ranked only on public facts: wallets that paid it more than once in the last 30 days (Coinbase's CDP catalog), whether it answered our unpaid request with a 402 last night, its price, and PayAI's uptime. Each result has the price, networks, method, and links to re-check every number. No match is never charged.

include_down.description: true to also list endpoints that did not answer our last unpaid request with a 402. Default false.

max_price_usd.description: Only endpoints whose catalog price is at most this, in USD.

need.description: What the endpoint should do, in plain words, up to 300 characters.

network.description: Only endpoints that take payment on this network: base, solana, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, algorand, or a CAIP-2 id.

sort.description: proven (default: most returning paying wallets first), cheapest, or fastest (our probe's response time).

name: find_x402_api
